product_metadata.title: mDesign Modern Plastic Kitchen Sink Countertop Liquid Hand Soap Dispenser Pump Bottle Caddy with Storage Compartment - Holds and Stores Sponges, Scrubbers and Brushes - Clear/Matte Black
features: STORAGE WITH STYLE: Liquid soap dispenser keeps hand or dish soap within easy reach on kitchen countertops and sinks; Ideal for soap, hand lotions, sanitizers and essential oils; Attached holder keep sponges, scrubbers, brushes and more in one convenient spot
GENEROUS CAPACITY: Each dispenser pump holds 16 ounces of liquid soap solution and is easy to refill with the removable pump head and wide mouth

COMPACT ORGANIZATION: The attached caddy holds sponges, scrubbers, sink stoppers, vegetable brushes, scrapers and scouring pads in one convenient place while keeping water off of kitchen counters; Place this convenient organizer next to bathroom sinks for storing and dispensing hand soap, use the side pocket to hold makeup brushes, eyeliners, eye pencils, lip liners and other small cosmetic essentials
QUALITY CONSTRUCTION: Made of durable BPA and Chlorine free plastic; Easy Care - clean with mild soap and water; Do not place in dishwasher
THOUGHTFULLY SIZED: Measures 3" x 4.6" x 7.75" high; Holds 16 oz.
